name: Finch Frost
lore: A living ice spirit who carries messages across the winter wilds and reads storms by the sound of snow on his scarf.
passive: Deep Winter: Ice attacks build Chill and progressively slow enemies. At full Chill, freeze them solid. Frozen enemies still take damage and gain a brief immunity to Chill after thawing.

technique.name: Icicle Fan
technique.description: Fire three short-range icicles. Each deals 8 damage and builds 16 Chill. Close targets can catch all three.

attack.name: Icicle Fan
attack.description: Fire three short-range icicles. Each deals 8 damage and builds 16 Chill. Close targets can catch all three.
attack.ui_brief: Fire three short-range icicles. Each deals 8 damage and builds 16 Chill. Close targets can catch all three.

final_technique.name: Glacier Break
final_technique.description: Mark an area and shatter it after a warning. Deal 34 damage and build 70 Chill, freezing chilled enemies when Deep Winter is active.

attack.name: Glacier Break
attack.description: Mark an area and shatter it after a warning. Deal 34 damage and build 70 Chill, freezing chilled enemies when Deep Winter is active.
attack.ui_brief: Mark an area and shatter it after a warning. Deal 34 damage and build 70 Chill, freezing chilled enemies when Deep Winter is active.

primary.name: Rime Spear
primary.description: Throw one piercing ice spear. Each enemy hit takes damage and gains 35 Chill. More Chill means a stronger movement slow.
primary.ui_brief: Throw one piercing ice spear. Each enemy hit takes damage and gains 35 Chill. More Chill means a stronger movement slow.

secondary.name: White Breath
secondary.description: Breathe frost in a cone for 2 seconds. The beam deals damage and builds Chill every quarter second.
secondary.ui_brief: Breathe frost in a cone for 2 seconds. The beam deals damage and builds Chill every quarter second.

special.name: Northwind Blizzard
special.description: Cast a wide snowstorm for 22 seconds. It hurts and chills enemies inside. Press Special again while aiming to steer it without refreshing its duration.
special.ui_brief: Cast a wide snowstorm for 22 seconds. It hurts and chills enemies inside. Press Special again while aiming to steer it without refreshing its duration.
